description: Claude Code via `ollama launch`, as a bare stateless engine node — the same three wakes as engine-ollama-claude, invoked with --permissions bypass, which for claude is --permission-mode bypassPermissions: the node runs without prompting, and deny rules in settings.json still apply. Requires a8s var MODEL (`a8s add ... --model=...` or `a8s vars <name> set MODEL ...`). An unrestricted node acts on untrusted inbound mail — anyone who can reach its inbox, including over a broker or a shared folder, is driving a CLI that will not ask. Only for an agent on its own machine and its own account. Turn timeout defaults to 900s; override per node with `a8s vars <name> set TIMEOUT <secs>`. Set EFFORT to an engine-supported reasoning level; unset uses the engine default. Commit as the agent with `a8s vars <name> set GIT_NAME ...` and `GIT_EMAIL ...`; unset uses git's own config.
